messages:
maria: CI red on linux-py38 for test_atomic_counter_randomized — intermittent assertion about counter value. Happens ~2/50 runs. Anyone seen this?

maria: failing snippet:
```
E   AssertionError: expected 100, got 99
runtime/tests/allocator_test.py::test_atomic_counter_randomized
  at runtime/allocator.py:243
```

ajohnson: saw something similar yesterday on my branch, looked timing-related. job: https://ci.redwood.ai/teams/infra/builds/12345

ci-bot: Build 12345: failed — test_atomic_counter_randomized — logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/logs/12345

dmitri: likely nondeterminism. test uses random.shuffle + time.sleep(0.001) in a tight loop. Recommend setting TEST_SEED and avoid real sleeps.

leila: putting it on the flaky-bisect queue. can you try reproducing with: `pytest -k atomic_counter -rA -q --count=50` inside the linux docker image?

maria: can't repro on mac, but inside `./ci/image:linux-py38` I get 1/50 failures when running in a loop.

ajohnson: maybe the counter size influences the window. try ATOMIC_COUNTER_COUNT=1000 in env for a rerun.

dmitri: also search for usages of `time.time()` in the test/impl — prefer `time.monotonic()` for timeouts; system clock jumps can flip assertions.

maria: good point. I'll push a tiny test patch that seeds RNG and replaces `time.time()` with `time.monotonic()` in the test harness, then rerun CI.

leila: if that doesn't fix it I'll bisect the seed range. ping me and I'll run the bisect job (takes ~30 min).

maria: pushed: small PR to set TEST_SEED=1234 and swap to monotonic. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/998

ajohnson: queued rerun: Build 12367 (with PR changes).

ci-bot: Build 12367: started — running tests on linux-py38.

ci-bot: Build 12367: passed — all tests green :tada:

maria: nice, looks stable so far. leaving a follow-up note to track allocator hotspots separately.

dmitri: fine to merge once staging passes; request one more review @ajohnson.

ajohnson: LGTM, will merge after staging green.

leila: added flaky tracker ticket #342 with repro notes and seed info.

maria: thanks all :thumbsup:
